text: During public preview the maximum logical-data capacity is 128 TB. An optional cap accepts 1 GB through 128 TB; leaving it unset allows 128 TB, and the configured cap can be increased or decreased after creation. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

text: The preview API sets the cap through replicationSpecs[].regionConfigs[].autoScaling.storageConfig.shardSizeLimitGB, documented as 1 through 131072 GB. Its autoScaling nesting does not imply a user-selectable storage auto-scaling switch. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

text: The API reference says that including replicationSpecs while omitting storageConfig or shardSizeLimitGB clears the custom limit; omitting replicationSpecs preserves it.
